lines.text: Many learners say: I look forward to see you.
Better: I look forward to seeing you.
After this to, say seeing, not see.
Watching! We look forward to watching it.

native.hook: look forward to の後ろ、動詞の形は大丈夫？
native.tip: look forward to の to は前置詞。だから後ろは seeing のように -ing 形。
native.caption: “I look forward to see you.”と言っていませんか？😅 「to の後ろは原形」と覚えていて原形にしがちですが、この to は前置詞なので -ing 形が正解。“I look forward to seeing you.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“watching”。look forward to の後ろは -ing 形。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.hook: Is your verb right after “look forward to”?
en.tip: The to here is a preposition, so use the ing form.
en.caption: Do you say “I look forward to see you.”? 😅 The to in this phrase is a preposition, so the verb takes ing. The natural way is “I look forward to seeing you.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
